answer_1.quote: cross-modal language generation tasks, such as automatic image captioning

answer_2.quote: automated evaluation metrics for image captioning such as BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR, CIDEr, and SPICE

answer_4.quote: our evaluations are done using fine-grained, side-by-side human evaluations using paid raters
answer_4.guideline: the raters are shown the image with the two captions randomly placed to the left vs. right, and are asked to compare the captions on a side-by-side rating scale. In addition, they are asked to also provide an absolute rating for each caption.
